name: RAGTruth
purpose: Groundedness and hallucination evaluation against human annotations.
language: English source corpus; model responses and prompts are preserved as published
local_preparation: python -m evalops dataset prepare ragtruth --output-dir datasets/external/ragtruth
notes: Human annotations are ground truth. Evaluator predictions are separate. Strict groundedness counts implicit_true spans; factual-correctness excludes only implicit_true spans. Quality defaults to good and reports excluded rows.
